title: SmartFruit MobileNetV2 based
training_data_and_results: Existing JosephMoustaid/smart-fruit-models-notebooks model. Nine classes: apple/banana/orange times fresh/rotten/unripe. Local training not performed. Original training dataset/split and independently measured accuracy unavailable. Redistribution terms unresolved; retained for local baseline comparison.
preprocessing_and_runtime: 96RGB, nearest resize, pixel/255. LiteRT CPU2threads. Nine probability outputs; no unsupported-fruit rejection.
architecture: Original trainable parameter/layer count cannot be recovered reliably from the optimized TFLite graph alone. Graph weight and operator counts are separately measured in inspection.json.
